title: 第18章 嫂子刚洗完澡，你闻闻香不香？
novel_title: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
刘美玉提前给李大壮留好了门，李大壮直接冲进院子，就看见刚洗完澡的刘美玉，一头乌黑的长发还湿哒哒的垂在雪白的肩膀上，身上穿着一条吊带紫色蕾丝花边睡裙。

    紫色不但很有女人味，还非常衬肤色，刘美玉露出来的肌肤都在月光的照映下，透着细腻的白。

    因为此时她正弯腰看向地上的大盆，本就低垂的衣领，垂的更低了，露出里面没穿胸罩的半片雪白，跟着刘美玉的动作自然下坠，像是两滴莹白的水珠，悬挂在刘美玉身前，惹人怜爱向往……

    “大壮！你还傻看啥呢？赶紧来看看你这个大老鳖咋回事啊！？”

    刘美玉听见声音，一看是李大壮来了，连忙快步走过去，拉着李大壮的手就往大盆那边拽。

    刘美玉的手特别柔软细腻，随着走动扭来扭去的屁股，壮观圆润，刚洗完澡的身子，还散发着一股淡淡的沐浴露香味，混合着她自己特有的女人香……

    李大壮刚才跟秋霜姐折腾半天，却没能得到释放的火苗，再次升腾起来！

    不过眼下还是先救老鳖要紧，李大壮压下体内燥热，连忙查看起盆里的老鳖。

    “我洗澡前这东西还睁着俩眼睛看呢，等我洗完澡出来，它就闭了眼睛，一动也不动了，我戳它鳖壳，它都没反应！”

    “大壮，它不会是死了吧？”刘美玉的美眸里全是担忧和内疚：“也不知道死了还值钱不？都怪我没照看好它，要是活着卖掉，你就能赚到钱补贴家用了！”

    “嫂子，不用自责，这玩意儿死了也能卖钱！”李大壮心里也没底，但还是笑呵呵的安慰刘美玉：“况且要不是你，我也抓不到这宝贝啊！”

    刘美玉闻言心里舒坦多了，美眸里的担忧化成了点点情丝，水波荡漾的看着李大壮：“傻小子，就你会安慰嫂子！”

    这么贴心的男人，说啥也让他成为自己的男人！

    “我可不是安慰嫂子，是这大老鳖，压根就没死！”李大壮刚才忽然心念一动，感知到老鳖只是晕倒了，并没死。

    正好之前在家趁着饭前的功夫，修炼了一会儿，现在体内多了些真气，李大壮便对准老鳖头，将真气输给了这家伙！
content_en:
"Sister-in-law, don't be busy, I'll just take Lao Turtle back!" Li Dazhuang was not willing to let Sister Qiu Shuang wait for too long, so he had to move Liu Meiyu to the back first.

    "You're not spending the night at your sister-in-law's house?" Liu Meiyu suddenly became resentful, her beautiful eyes full of grievance and reluctance.

    "Ahem, what, my mother left the door open for me, I have to go back, otherwise she should be anxious." Li Dazhuang didn't dare to look anymore, and quickly picked up the old turtle and walked out: "Sister-in-law, don't forget to lock the door, I'm leaving first."

    "Bad boy~ Come to my sister-in-law's house when you have time. My sister-in-law's big white steamed buns are always ready for you..."

    "I know!"

    Li Dazhuang endured the heat, closed the door and ran away, leaving Liu Meiyu alone on the chair, sullen and self-pitying: "You brat, just hang on to my sister-in-law. You will wait for the next time. I will take you down no matter what my sister-in-law says..."

    Little did he know that Li Dazhuang regretted it when he ran home, because after Sister Qiu Shuang sent him the message, she lay down on his wooden bed and fell asleep!

    Sister Qiu Shuang was sleeping gracefully on the bed. Because she was lying on her stomach, she could only see a ring of snow-white flesh squeezed out from her side, hidden in her sarong, which was eye-catching.

    But the most eye-catching thing is her round buttocks. Although it is covered by the hem of the skirt, the curvature is amazing. Because of her sleeping position, the hem of the skirt is rubbed higher up, but it can barely cover her buttocks. It is so beautiful that it is almost invisible.

    Not to mention the two beautiful legs that are not covered. They are so white and slender that they will not get tired of them after playing for several years. If I have to change a pair of stockings every day...

    Li Dazhuang became even more "irritated" in an instant. He shook his head quickly. After all, he still couldn't bear to wake up Sister Qiu Shuang. He could only take a cold bath with the old turtle, and then put the old turtle into the water tank. Only then did he remember that he couldn't practice with the beauty today, so he had to practice by himself!

    "Fortunately, there is a mountain behind the village. There is more spiritual energy in the mountain, which should be enough for me to practice!"

    In order to absorb the spiritual energy more easily, Li Dazhuang simply jumped on the roof and started practicing cross-legged!

    A steady stream of spiritual energy poured into Li Dazhuang's Dantian from the back mountain, and was then cultivated into his own energy using the secret method of Hehuan Sect!

    When the sky just broke, Li Dazhuang opened his eyes, his bright eyes radiating light, the true energy in his dantian was flowing, and his body seemed to have endless strength!

    "It seems that practicing can replenish physical strength more than sleeping!" Li Dazhuang jumped off the roof in surprise. When he returned to his room, he almost saw blood from his nose!

    Sister Qiu Shuang was so dishonest when sleeping. Last night her skirt could barely cover her buttocks, but now it had reached her waist. The pink and white panties were no longer covered, completely exposed to Li Dazhuang. It allowed him to see clearly the skin color of her buttocks, which was as white as the snow-capped mountains in front of her...

    Moreover, Sister Qiu Shuang is sleeping sideways with one leg on Li Dazhuang's quilt, which makes it easier for her to expose places that shouldn't be exposed...
title_en: Chapter 19 Those two big white legs, it feels so good to touch them!
